**Choose the home screen's background**

Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ **Home background** offers four backgrounds, shown alive in a picture above their few settings: **Ridges** (the mountains under a glow, made of dots, still the default), **Waves** (smooth bands of colour that rise from the foot and melt into each other, as at sunset), **Pixel** (the same waves in large square pixels) and **Prism** (crisp columns of colour drawing a crest, a valley, a tide, a slant or a lens, that expand, gather or breathe). Waves and Pixel come in six palettes, among them one that follows your accent colour, and Prism in six of its own; each palette shows its colours beside its name. Waves can be broader or softer and rise from any side. They look right without touching anything, keep the words over them legible in the light theme, the dark one and high contrast, cost almost nothing, and stand still with Reduce motion.
